new_jobs.title: Senior Manager, Site Reliability Engineering
new_jobs.description:
Company Overview

Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).

What you'll do

As Docusign transitions to a global, AI-powered Intelligent Agreement Management (IAM) platform, our infrastructure must be as innovative as our products. We are seeking a Senior Manager of SRE who operates with a Customer-First mindset and a strong sense of operational ownership. You will lead a high-performing team of SREs to evolve our reliability practices into a modern, engineering-first operation. You will drive the delivery of world-class reliability tools used internally by Docusign’s engineering teams to provide unprecedented transparency and trust in our platform.

This position is a people manager role reporting to the Director, Site Reliability Engineering.

Responsibility

Drive the day-to-day reliability, availability, and performance of Docusign’s global platform. You will ensure your team proactively monitors and maintains a resilient infrastructure that protects the customer experience
Lead engineering teams in developing and maintaining reliability tools, automation, and APIs used internally to accelerate developer velocity and support platform trust
Manage, mentor, and grow a team of SREs, including Senior and Staff-level engineers. Foster a culture of continuous learning, psychological safety, and technical excellence
Partner with product and dev teams to implement and monitor "Error Budgets" and SLOs. You understand that seconds of latency affect signers and downtime blocks business deals, and you advocate for the user in engineering discussions
Implement and champion the adoption of the Internal Developer Platform (IDP), making it seamless for our 2,000+ developers to build reliable services by default
Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Compliance to ensure operational alignment and smooth project delivery
Shift the team from reactive incident response to predictive mitigation by implementing Chaos Engineering practices and automated self-healing mechanisms

Job Designation

Remote:
Employee is not required to be in or near an office frequently and works from a designated remote work location for the majority of the time.

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.

What you bring

Basic

10+ years of experience in Infrastructure, SRE, or Software Engineering, with a minimum of 4 years of experience directly managing engineering teams in a high-scale SaaS environment
Experience guiding teams that build tools and automation, viewing infrastructure as code and internal developers as your primary users
Experience managing complex technical projects, handling incident management efficiently, and driving systems to higher standards of uptime
Experience making technical priority decisions based on user impact and translating technical metrics into customer trust
Experience solving modern operational problems with software automation
Experience with modern programming languages (such as Go or Python) to review code, guide architecture, and lead automation efforts

Preferred

Experience managing enterprise-grade container orchestration using Kubernetes (specifically Azure Kubernetes Service/AKS)
Experience contributing to or implementing Internal Developer Platforms (IDPs) that boost developer velocity and autonomy
Familiarity with infrastructure supporting AI/LLM workloads or predictive data pipelines
Hands-on experience with public cloud ecosystems (specifically Azure) and multi-region architectures

Wage Transparency

Pay for this position is based on a number of factors including geographic location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Based on applicable legislation, the below details pay ranges in the following locations:

California: $186,100.00 - $300,550.00 base salary

Illinois, Colorado, Massachusetts and Minnesota: $178,900.00 - $252,700.00 base salary

Washington, Maryland, New Jersey and New York (including NYC metro area): $178,900.00 - $262,825.00 base salary

Washington DC: $186,100.00 - $262,825.00 base salary

Ohio: $157,100.00 - $221,900.00 base salary

This Role Is Also Eligible For The Following

Bonus: Sales personnel are eligible for variable incentive pay dependent on their achievement of pre-established sales goals. Non-Sales roles are eligible for a company bonus plan, which is calculated as a percentage of eligible wages and dependent on company performance.
Stock: This role is eligible to receive Restricted Stock Units (RSUs).

Benefits

Global benefits provide options for the following:

Paid Time Off: earned time off, as well as paid company holidays based on region
Paid Parental Leave: take up to six months off with your child after birth, adoption or foster care placement
Full Health Benefits Plans: options for 100% employer paid and minimum employee contribution health plans from day one of employment
Retirement Plans: select retirement and pension programs with potential for employer contributions
Learning and Development: options for coaching, online courses and education reimbursements
Compassionate Care Leave: paid time off following the loss of a loved one and other life-changing events

Life at Docusign

Working here

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Will you shape the future or will the future shape you?

The opportunity

As part of the Americas Tax Technology Group (ATTG), you will be part of an organization that designs, builds, and operates AI-enabled digital products that empower our Tax professionals and clients. ATTG partners closely with the Tax practice to deliver secure, scalable, and responsible technology solutions, including digital and mobile tools, data platforms, analytics, dashboards, visualization, and emerging generative AI–driven experiences.

Our work is guided by AI principles:

Human-centered and value-driven AI
Responsible, secure, and compliant by design
Reuse before build; platforms over point solutions
AI embedded into workflows, not bolted on
Rapid experimentation with disciplined scale

The Development Senior Manager (DM) sits within the Solution Delivery pillar, responsible for leading the end-to-end delivery of AI-enabled products that support the Americas Tax practice.

This role blends people leadership, technical depth, and AI-informed decision making, ensuring products are delivered with speed, quality, and trust while aligning with firm architecture, security, and AI governance standards.

Your Key Responsibilities

Product Delivery Leadership:
Partner with Product Owners to design, plan, build, operate, and continuously improve one or more products within a portfolio, with a focus on AI-augmented capabilities
Own delivery outcomes including quality, reliability, performance, and long-term maintainability
Lead development teams to deliver secure, scalable, and cloud-native solutions, incorporating automation and AI where it drives measurable value
Ensure products meet 24x7 operational expectations, including leadership of urgent response teams for production issues

Agentic Engineering:
Drive the responsible adoption of generative AI and advanced analytics in product development, testing, support, and operations
Ensure AI solutions follow Responsible AI principles (security, privacy, explainability, compliance, and human oversight)
Promote reuse of AI patterns, components, accelerators, and platforms across products and portfolios
Embed AI into developer workflows (e.g., design, coding, testing, documentation, support) to improve speed and quality

Architecture, Standards & Platforms
Partner with Development Leads and Architects to create and maintain architecture artifacts including:
Infrastructure Architecture Documents (IAD)
Solution Design Documents (SDD)
AI architecture and integration patterns

Ensure adoption of Reference Architecture standards, development patterns, and engineering best practices
Drive consistency across teams while allowing flexibility for innovation and experimentation
Team & Talent Leadership

Lead and grow high-performing, inclusive development teams across onshore, offshore, and hybrid models
Set clear goals, assign work, manage performance, and conduct career development discussions
Coach teams to balance delivery excellence with innovation, leveraging AI as a force multiplier
Foster a culture of continuous learning, experimentation, and psychological safety
Coordinate closely with DevOps, Architecture, InfoSec, Data, and Platform teams
Create and maintain technical and AI roadmaps aligned with product and business strategy

Skills And Attributes For Success

Proven track record delivering mission-critical, 24x7 enterprise systems
Strong grounding in software engineering fundamentals and modern development practices
Deep understanding of distributed systems, Platforms and cloud-native architecture
Practical experience applying Agile / Lean delivery models
Ability to clearly articulate complex technical and AI-enabled solutions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Strong decision-making skills informed by data, quality metrics, and AI-assisted insights
Comfortable leading through ambiguity and driving predictable outcomes at scale

To qualify for the role you must have

Bachelor’s degree (Computer Science, Engineering, Accounting, Finance preferred) or equivalent experience
10–15 years of relevant experience
6+ years leading development teams using Agile/Lean practices
Approved technical certification is required
Design and deliver modern engineering solutions using Microsoft technology stack and AI technologies
Experience managing vendors and service providers
Strong executive presence and comfortable presenting to senior leadership

Ideally you will have

Master’s degree
Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, and platform engineering
Exposure to project and portfolio management
Tax domain experience

What We Look For

We are looking for leaders who:

Believe AI should augment people, not replace them
Balance speed with trust, security, and compliance
Think in terms of platforms, ecosystems, and reuse
Are energized by coaching teams through change
Want to make a measurable impact on how Tax professionals work every day

If you’re excited to lead teams building AI-powered, responsible, and scalable solutions that matter, we’d love to hear from you.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

What We Offer You

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job in all geographic locations in the US is $101,700 to $294,800. The base salary range for New York City Metro Area, Washington State and California (excluding Sacramento) is $122,000 to $335,100. Individual salaries within those ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.
Join us in our team-led and leader-enabled hybrid model. Our expectation is for most people in external, client serving roles to work together in person 60% of the time over the course of an engagement, project or year.
Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

Does this position interest you? You should apply – even if you don’t match every single requirement! We're known as an auto glass company. That's the focus of what we do. But beyond the glass, we're so much more. We'll help you build a fulfilling career and encourage you to have a life. Let us be the best place you'll ever work.

A Brief Overview

The Senior Manager of BI Engineering and Data Products
will lead the technical execution of complex, enterprise analytics initiatives and build a high-performing BI Engineering and Data Products organization.

This position will set technical and architectural direction for scalable, governed BI platforms and data products, partner closely with Data Engineering and IT engineering teams to solve ambiguous problems, and translate enterprise priorities into durable roadmaps that deliver trusted analytics outcomes at scale.

Expected Work Location (In Office)
: It is expected that you will primarily perform work at the Safelite Home Office (7400 Safelite Way, Columbus, OH 43235). You are required to work in the office at least 4 days a week. Changes to work location arrangements are subject to managerial approval and business needs.

What You Will Do

Provide technical and people leadership for the BI Engineering and Data Products team: Sets architectural direction and governs BI engineering standards to ensure scalable, reliable analytics solutions. Manages and develops BI Engineers and BI Developers through performance management, coaching, and workforce planning, and serves as the escalation point for complex, cross‑functional technical and delivery issues.
Scope, decompose, and lead execution of complex BI engineering problems across a variety of functional areas: Analyzes ambiguous business and analytical needs and translates them into well‑defined BI engineering designs and work plans. Deconstructs complex or legacy reporting workflows and guides the application of computer science and analytics engineering principles to ensure solutions are performant, extensible, and maintainable.
Oversee BI pipeline engineering quality and delivery: Ensures end‑to‑end quality of BI pipelines from semantic and metrics layers through dashboards and downstream data products by establishing and enforcing standards for data modeling, testing, documentation, version control, and CI/CD. Drives consistent engineering practices to improve reliability, scalability, and speed of analytics delivery.
Design and evolve BI semantic and reporting architecture: Leads the design and continuous improvement of shared semantic layers, metrics frameworks, and reusable BI components. Partners closely with Data Engineering and IT engineering teams to align BI solutions with enterprise data platforms, ingestion patterns, and architectural standards, enabling scalable self‑service analytics.
Define and communicate business and technical value of BI initiatives: Quantifies the impact of BI solutions and communicates value to Product, Engineering, and Business leaders to inform prioritization, sequencing, and investment decisions. Ensures BI roadmaps balance business outcomes, technical complexity, and architectural alignment.
Establish and oversee BI platform governance and operations: Directs governance and operational management of BI platforms, including Tableau Cloud administration, access controls, content certification, automation, and quality monitoring. Ensures BI platforms operate as stable, well‑governed engineering systems with clear ownership and observability.
Performs other duties as assigned
Complies with all policies and standards

What You Will Need

Bachelor's Degree in computer science, engineering, analytics, or related field Required
7-9 years hands on experience in a data engineering or analytics related role Required
4-6 years managing a technical team Required
7-9 years Advanced SQL development, including complex transformations, performance optimization, and data modeling. Required
4-6 years Experience with modern cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake or similar). Required
4-6 years Experience using Python or other programming languages for data transformation, automation, or analytics workflows. Required
4-6 years Experience with modern analytics engineering tools (e.g., dbt, FiveTran) and CI/CD practices. Required
Expert-level SQL knowledge, including advanced query optimization, window functions, CTEs, nested queries, and complex transformations used in enterprise analytics workflows. High (High proficiency)
Advanced proficiency in Python or similar programming languages for analytics engineering, automation, workflow orchestration, and operational reporting. High (High proficiency)
Ability to technically scope, decompose, and solve abstract analytical problems by translating ambiguous business needs into well-defined BI engineering designs using computer science and analytics engineering principles. High (High proficiency)
Deep knowledge of BI and analytics engineering architecture, including the design and evolution of governed semantic layers, metrics frameworks, and reusable analytics components. High (High proficiency)

new_jobs.title: Director of Engineering
new_jobs.description:
DEMGY Pacific | Tacoma, Washington

Build the System Behind Exceptional Engineering

Are you a strategic engineering leader
who sees the entire journey from initial concept and tooling strategy through production readiness, continuous improvement, and product sustainment?

At DEMGY
, you’ll connect people, processes, and technology
across the complete product lifecycle. You’ll create clarity, eliminate inefficiencies, and build scalable engineering systems that improve cost, quality, delivery, and customer outcomes.

Since 1947
, DEMGY has combined the stability and resources of an established global organization with an environment where your ideas, leadership, and results can make a visible impact.

What You’ll Lead

Reporting to the VP of Operations, you’ll provide strategic and operational leadership
across Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Tooling, and Project Engineering
.

You Will

Establish and execute an engineering strategy that supports growth, operational excellence, and customer commitments.
Lead engineering programs from concept and development through production, sustainment, and end-of-life.
Optimize NPI, production readiness, tooling strategies, manufacturability, and engineering processes.
Connect Engineering, Quality, Production, Supply Chain, Finance, and Business Development to improve execution across the operation.
Drive engineering capacity, resource planning, program cost and risk evaluation, and capital and tooling decisions.
Establish meaningful KPIs and use them to identify bottlenecks, improve performance, and create greater efficiency.
Provide visible leadership when engineering challenges affect quality, cost, delivery, customers, or compliance.
Build capable, accountable teams while championing Lean, Kaizen, 5S, safety, and continuous improvement.

You’ll Thrive Here If You…

Naturally connect people, processes, and priorities.
Enjoy doing complex work from beginning to end and making every stage more effective.
See inefficiencies as opportunities to design a better way forward.
Want autonomy to make decisions and the accountability to deliver results.

new_jobs.title: Sr. Director, Product & Technology Marketing— Optical & Data Center Systems
new_jobs.description:
About Marvell

Marvell’s semiconductor solutions are the essential building blocks of the data infrastructure that connects our world. Across enterprise, cloud and AI, and carrier architectures, our innovative technology is enabling new possibilities.

At Marvell, you can affect the arc of individual lives, lift the trajectory of entire industries, and fuel the transformative potential of tomorrow. For those looking to make their mark on purposeful and enduring innovation, above and beyond fleeting trends, Marvell is a place to thrive, learn, and lead.

Your Team, Your Impact

Marvell's Global Marketing organization mission is to accelerate Marvell’s growth by delivering impactful outcomes and services that elevate our brand, captivate our target audiences, and exceed stakeholder expectations. The organization encompasses communications, digital, events, social, analyst relations, marketing research, and portfolio marketing. We collaborate closely with Marvell's business units, investor relations, finance, HR, and executive staff to ensure our messaging and positioning resonate effectively with diverse global audiences.

What You Can Expect

The Sr. Director, Product & Technology Marketing for the Data Center Networking Business Group will own the outbound marketing strategy for Marvell's photonic fabric, co-packaged optics (CPO), optical connectivity, data center switching, and data center interconnect (DCI) portfolio. This is a high-stakes, system-level marketing role — the target audience is not component buyers, but platform decision-makers: system architects at hyperscalers and data center operators who are making infrastructure-level choices about how to scale AI clusters beyond the rack. The marketing challenge is translating silicon-level photonic innovation into a compelling end-to-end narrative about the future of AI-scale connectivity — from millimeters between chips on a co-packaged optics module, to photonic fabric and high-radix switching connecting XPU to XPU within the cluster, to coherent DCI solutions spanning kilometers between data centers.

Product Marketing & Outbound Strategy

Own the full outbound marketing strategy for Marvell's Optical & Data Center Systems portfolio — amplifying Marvell's market-leading connectivity position across photonic fabric, CPO, data center switching, and coherent DCI — through differentiated positioning, compelling messaging, and targeted channel activation that drives awareness and preference with hyperscaler and data center operator audiences.
Define and maintain differentiated value propositions and messaging hierarchies for each portfolio segment; ensure consistent, compelling communication of Marvell's competitive advantages to external audiences.
Lead product launch planning and execution, driving cross-functional readiness across sales, PR, analyst relations, digital, and events to maximize market impact at launch.
Develop competitive response playbooks and sales enablement content — including pitch decks, solution briefs, battle cards, and objection-handling guides — that equip customer-facing teams to win.
Partner with product management and engineering teams to deeply understand technology roadmaps; translate product capabilities into external marketing strategies, not internal product plans.

Technology Marketing & Thought Leadership

Build and execute a technology marketing strategy that establishes Marvell as the recognized leader in optical-scale AI infrastructure — telling the end-to-end story of AI connectivity from millimeters between chips on a co-packaged optics module, to photonic fabric and high-radix switching connecting XPU to XPU within the cluster, to coherent DCI solutions spanning kilometers between data centers.
Create a pipeline of compelling thought leadership assets including white papers, solution briefs, executive presentations, keynote narratives, and technical blogs that translate silicon-level innovation into customer and industry impact.
Partner with executive and product leadership to develop and sharpen Marvell's technology narrative for major industry forums, analyst briefings, customer events, and investor communications.
Act as a senior voice of the market — tracking industry trends, competitive dynamics, and customer requirements to continuously sharpen Marvell's positioning.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Organizational Influence

Serve as the primary outbound marketing partner to product line executives and product management teams — translating roadmap inputs into external marketing strategies, audience narratives, and campaign execution.
Collaborate across marketing functions — corporate, digital, events, AR/PR, and content — to ensure portfolio messaging is consistently amplified across all channels and touchpoints.
Establish shared messaging frameworks, launch standards, and audience segmentation playbooks that scale across Marvell's business units and marketing organization.
Represent the marketing function in senior leadership forums, ensuring outbound marketing strategy and investment priorities are informed by market insight and tied to business outcomes.

What We're Looking For

BS degree required; a degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline is highly preferred. MBA or MS in a business or quantitative discipline valued in addition to an engineering foundation.
15+ years of progressive experience in outbound product marketing or technology marketing within the semiconductor, systems, or AI infrastructure industry — candidates with pure product management backgrounds will not be considered.
Deep expertise in AI/data center optical infrastructure — including co-packaged optics (CPO), silicon photonics, data center switching, and coherent DCI — with demonstrated understanding of the hyperscaler and data center operator buyer landscape, platform-level purchasing dynamics, and the competitive and technology trends shaping next-generation AI scale-up connectivity.
Demonstrated track record of leading complex, multi-product outbound marketing programs — from audience strategy and positioning through campaign execution — with measurable business results.
Exceptional ability to synthesize highly technical concepts into external audience narratives, customer value stories, and industry thought leadership that drives awareness and preference.
Proven experience developing and activating marketing content across the full outbound mix: executive presentations, white papers, solution briefs, digital campaigns, event activations, and media/analyst engagement.
Strong cross-functional influence skills — able to collaborate effectively with product management without conflating the two disciplines; clear understanding of where marketing responsibility begins and ends.
Strong executive presence and communication skills — confident presenting to partners, at industry conferences, and in internal leadership settings.
Experience building and leading teams; strong track record recruiting, developing, and retaining top marketing talent.

Preferred

Experience working with or marketing to hyperscalers, cloud service providers, and data center operators making platform-level infrastructure decisions — particularly system architects evaluating optical scale-up architectures.
Deep familiarity with co-packaged optics (CPO) architectures and advanced optical solutions — including photonic integrated circuits (PICs), silicon photonics light engines, and coherent DCI technologies — and the ecosystem dynamics required to bring next-generation optical connectivity to commercial scale.
Track record of building or scaling a product marketing function; prior people management experience a strong plus.
Track record of representing a company at major optical and data center industry forums; experience such as OFC, ECOC, OCP, OIF, and other relevant standards bodies or equivalent strongly preferred.

Expected Base Pay Range (USD)

199,090 - 298,200, $ per annum

The successful candidate’s starting base pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location and market conditions. The expected base pay range for this role may be modified based on market conditions.

Additional Compensation And Benefit Elements

Marvell is committed to providing exceptional, comprehensive benefits that support our employees at every stage - from internship to retirement and through life’s most important moments. Our offerings are built around four key pillars: financial well-being, family support, mental and physical health, and recognition. Highlights include an employee stock purchase plan with a 2-year look back, family support programs to help balance work and home life, robust mental health resources to prioritize emotional well-being, and a recognition and service awards to celebrate contributions and milestones. We look forward to sharing more with you during the interview process.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.

Any applicant who requires a reasonable accommodation during the selection process should contact Marvell HR Helpdesk at TAOps@marvell.com.

These tools must not be used to record, assist with, or enhance responses in any way. Our interviews are designed to evaluate your individual experience, thought process, and communication skills in real time. Use of AI tools without prior instruction from the interviewer will result in disqualification from the hiring process.

As such, applicants must be eligible to access export-controlled information as defined under applicable law. Marvell may be required to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce and/or the U.S. Department of State. new_jobs.title: Vice President, Technology
new_jobs.description:
Alliance for Audited Media seeking an experienced Vice President, Technology who will be responsible for the leadership and management of the organization's technology infrastructure, cybersecurity, enterprise applications, software development, and IT operations. This primarily position reports to the Chief Financial Officer/ Chief Operating Officer. This position leads the planning and execution of strategic technology initiatives and is accountable for technology investments and outcomes, while ensuring reliable, secure, and cost-effective technology services that support the organization's business objectives.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS OF THE JOB

Lead the technology function and establish technology priorities and direction in partnership with executive leadership and in alignment with organizational goals, business needs, and strategic objectives.

Establish and maintain an effective technology governance framework for evaluating, prioritizing, and overseeing technology initiatives, investments, and resources.

Develop and manage the annual IT operating and capital budgets, including technology forecasting, resource planning, and evaluation of proposed technology investments.

Oversee the organization's technology platforms, business applications, infrastructure, and systems, including evaluation, modernization, integration, and lifecycle management.

Oversee cybersecurity, technology risk management, data protection, and related controls to safeguard organizational information and technology resources.

Manage enterprise infrastructure, including Microsoft 365, Azure, AWS, virtualization, servers, networking, backup, and disaster recovery.

Recommend and implement cost-effective technology solutions that ensure secure, reliable, and high-performing systems.

Oversee IT operations, help desk support, and relationships with technology vendors, contractors, and managed service providers, including contract performance and service delivery.

Supervise IT staff by providing leadership, mentoring, coaching, staff development and succession planning, and performance management.

Lead knowledge transfer and documentation efforts to preserve institutional knowledge, strengthen  business continuity, and reduce operational dependency.

Develop and maintain IT policies, procedures, documentation, and technology standards.

Serve as a strategic technology advisor to executive leadership, communicating technology priorities, investments, risks, opportunities, and results in support of informed business decisions.

Evaluate emerging technologies and industry practices and recommend solutions that improve organizational effectiveness, security, reliability, and operational efficiency.

OTHER KEY JOB FUNCTIONS

Collaborate with department leaders to identify opportunities for process improvement through technology.
Support enterprise data management and reporting initiatives that improve business decision-making.
Participate in cross-functional projects and organizational initiatives as needed.
Maintain current knowledge of emerging technologies, cybersecurity trends, and industry best practices and apply that knowledge to support organizational technology planning and decision-making.
Present technology plans, risks, priorities, and initiatives to executive leadership as needed, and as requested, to the Board of Directors.
Perform other duties as assigned.

JOB SPECIFICATIONS

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field.
Minimum 10 years of progressive IT experience.
Minimum 5 years leading technical teams or enterprise IT projects.
Experience developing and executing technology strategies, governance practices, and technology investment priorities aligned with organizational objectives.
Experience managing technology vendors, contractors, and managed service providers, including contract negotiations, performance management, and service delivery.
Experience overseeing cloud platforms, infrastructure, networking, cybersecurity, data protection, and enterprise applications.
Experience leading application development or legacy system modernization, or cloud migration projects.
Strong knowledge of databases, systems integration, and enterprise technologies.
Excellent leadership, project management, vendor management, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to communicate technical concepts effectively to executive leadership and non-technical stakeholders.
Experience with technologies such as Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Microsoft 365, Azure, AWS, or comparable enterprise platforms is preferred.
Experience with cybersecurity, data protection, business continuity, and disaster recovery practices is preferred.
Microsoft, Cisco, Azure, AWS, VMware, or related certifications preferred.

ENVIRONMENT:

Primarily remote work environment.
Periodic onsite presence at AAM's Schaumburg, Illinois office during the first nine months will be expected to support knowledge transfer and transition activities.
Occasional travel for company meetings, technology implementations, or vendor meetings as required.
Availability to work outside normal business hours during system implementations, maintenance windows, or emergency situations.

About Alliance for Audited Media

The Alliance for Audited Media is the industry’s assurance partner. Founded in 1914 by the Association of National Advertisers as the Audit Bureau of Circulations (ABC), AAM has evolved from verifying print circulation to providing assurance across the media and advertising ecosystem. In 2023, AAM merged with BPA Worldwide to become the largest not-for-profit media assurance organization governed by a board of directors representing agencies, marketers and publishers.

Our mission is to collaborate with the industry to set standards and develop assurance programs that bring greater transparency to channels including digital, print, retail media, events, out-of-home, ad tech and more.

AAM partners with leading organizations including the Association of National Advertisers (ANA), Interactive Advertising Bureau (IAB), IAB Tech Lab, Trustworthy Accountability Group (TAG), the Events Industry Council (EIC), Point of Care Marketing Association (POCMA) and others to set industry standards and develop assurance programs that promote greater transparency and accountability.

Together with our members and partners, we are committed to setting universal benchmarks for media transparency, helping develop accountability solutions and promoting excellence that elevates the entire industry.

As AAM continues to evolve its technology capabilities in support of its mission, the Vice President, Technology will play a key leadership role in ensuring that AAM's technology environment supports the organization's business objectives, innovation, security, and continued growth.

Job Type: Full-time

Language: English (Required)

Work authorization: United States (Required). Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employer sponsorship.

Travel: Occasional travel for company meetings, technology implementations, or vendor meetings as required.

new_jobs.title: Senior Manager, Engineering (821)
new_jobs.description:
At Protegrity, we lead innovation by using AI and quantum-resistant cryptography to transform data protection across cloud-native, hybrid, on-premises, and open source environments. We leverage advanced cryptographic methods such as tokenization, format-preserving encryption, and quantum-resilient techniques to protect sensitive data.

As a global leader in data security, our mission is to ensure that data isn’t just valuable but also usable, trusted, and safe.

Protegrity offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of innovation and collaboration, with the ability to make a meaningful impact on the industry while working alongside some of the brightest minds. Together, we are redefining how the world safeguards data, enabling organizations to thrive in a GenAI era where data is the ultimate currency. If you're ready to shape the future of data security, Protegrity is the place for you.

Protegrity is seeking a passionate and talented Senior Manager of Engineering to join our Engineering organization. This position is a remote role.

Role Overview

You enjoy leading teams that ship customer-facing product experiences at scale. You bring strong front-end engineering depth, pair it with pragmatic people leadership, and love building reusable platform capabilities that help multiple product teams move faster.

In this role you’ll lead 2–3 product teams (including the core UI team), set technical direction for a micro-frontend architecture and shell SDK, and stay close to the code—especially when a problem needs hands-on help. You’ll also champion AI-assisted development practices to accelerate delivery while keeping quality, security, and accessibility bar-high.

What You’ll Do

Lead 2–3 product engineering teams (including the core UI team), providing day-to-day management, coaching, mentoring, and performance support while maintaining a strong technical presence.
Set technical direction for the UI platform: micro-frontend architecture, React/TypeScript standards, shell SDK interfaces, module contracts, and shared design-system/theming patterns.
Drive engineering execution: sprint planning, technical prioritization, code reviews, and hands-on contributions to unblock delivery and improve reliability.
Establish and evolve CI/CD for independently deployable front-end modules, including build pipelines, artifact management, automated testing, and safe rollout practices.
Ensure reusable UI and service capabilities are well-designed and documented (including company-wide ‘skills files’/patterns), and guide integration with supporting backend services such as user management and authorization.
Partner closely with Product Management to define roadmap, scope features, and deliver high-impact product outcomes.
Define and maintain clear module contracts, API descriptors, and SDK interfaces to enable independent development across teams.
Promote scalable integration patterns including event-driven communication and shared state approaches across modules and services.
Drive engineering best practices across teams including coding standards, testing strategies, and development workflows (including AI-assisted tools where appropriate).

What You’ll Need

8+ years of software engineering experience with 3+ years leading and managing engineers (or equivalent combination of education and experience).
Strong React 18+ expertise (hooks, Suspense, StrictMode, error boundaries, lazy loading) and modern TypeScript patterns.
Deep experience with Webpack 5 and Module Federation or similar approaches to modular front-end architecture.
Experience designing and operating micro-frontend systems or other independently deployable UI architectures.
Solid experience integrating or developing backend services, including API design and microservices-based architectures.
Familiarity with event-driven communication patterns (pub/sub) and cross-module state management approaches.
Experience implementing or working with authentication and authorization patterns (e.g., JWT, RBAC).
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern development practices including testing and code quality standards.
Strong collaboration skills with product, design, and engineering teams, with the ability to balance technical decisions and delivery outcomes.

Nice to have

Experience with containerization and Kubernetes or similar cloud-native deployment models.
Strong understanding of UI architecture concepts such as design systems, theming, and responsive design.
Experience with accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1) and building inclusive user experiences.
Exposure to AI/LLM-powered UI experiences or developer productivity tools.

Should you accept this position, you must consent to and pass a Background Investigation, which includes (subject to country law), extended education, and additional criminal and civil checks.

We offer a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits with generous vacation and holiday time off. All employees are also provided access to ongoing learning & development. Ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace is our priority.

We are committed to an environment of acceptance where you are free to bring your full self to work. All qualified applicants and current employees will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability or veteran status.

Please reference Section 12: Supplemental Notice for Job Applicants in our Privacy Policy to inform you of the categories of personal information that we collect from individuals who inquire about and/or apply to work for Protegrity USA, Inc., or its parent company, subsidiaries or affiliates, and the purposes for which we use such personal information.

Compensation Range: $199.2K - $217.5K

new_jobs.title: Senior Manager, Market Solutions Engineering
new_jobs.description:
The New York Independent System Operator (NYISO) manages the efficient flow of electricity on more than 11,000 circuit-miles of high-voltage transmission lines, dispatching power from hundreds of generating units across the state.

The New York Independent System Operator (NYISO) applies cutting-edge technology to operating a reliable electricity system, managing competitive markets for wholesale electricity, and planning for the Empire State's energy future. The NYISO’s Market Structures department invites applications for a full-time Senior Manager, Market Solutions Engineering.

The Senior Manager, Market Solutions Engineering is responsible for setting technical direction and leading the research, market technology, production support, implementation, and external engagement functions that support NYISO’s energy, capacity, and TCC market systems. This position provides strategic leadership across Market Design, Market Operations, Grid Operations, Market Mitigation and Analysis, Information Technology, System & Resource Planning, and Product and Project Management to advance NYISO’s strategic initiatives and long-term market vision.

The Senior Manager leads the development and evolution of market technology solutions, oversees preliminary and feasibility simulation studies for future market products, and ensures market applications remain functional and aligned with market rules and reliability criteria. The role also directs projects that build upon the Energy Market System and Business Market System to support emerging resource technologies and New York State renewable integration objectives.

The position provides leadership for day-ahead and real-time energy market engineering support, production issue resolution, vendor and consultant engagement, implementation readiness, testing coordination, external research engagements, and ongoing technical support for market software and market participant inquiries.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES And RESPONSIBILITIES

Provide strategic leadership for Market Solutions Engineering and Market Research and Engineering teams, including research, prototype development, market technology strategy, implementation support, production support, and long-term market solution planning.
Lead collaboration with Market Design, Project and Product Management, Information Technology, Operations, Grid Operations, Market Mitigation and Analysis, System & Resource Planning, and other business areas through the full project lifecycle, from market design and requirements development through implementation, testing, deployment, and post-production support.
Direct engagement with vendors and consultants supporting NYISO production systems and market applications; review vendor-proposed solutions, provide direction on design notes development and ensure solutions align with market rules, operational needs, reliability criteria, and long-range market strategies.
Provide strategic direction to Grid Operations and Market Operations teams regarding production changes, market software enhancements, prioritization of improvements, and resolution of software issues encountered in day-ahead and real-time market operations.
Define, sponsor and lead studies of future market products and technologies using prototyping, simulations, historical data analysis, and other sound technical approaches to validate requirements, assess technical robustness, evaluate potential market outcomes and consumer impacts, identify market behavioral risks and confirm compliance objectives.
Present, explain and defend technical approaches, study results, implementation strategies and recommended solutions to senior management, stakeholders, vendors, and internal cross-functional teams.
Balance market operations and grid operations operational enhancements with NYISO’s long-term market plans and strategic planning priorities.
Lead the technical development of mathematical models and optimization-based solutions for energy, capacity, and TCC markets, including commitment, dispatch, pricing, resource adequacy modeling approaches to meet peak system demand and capacity accreditation factors used in resource adequacy models.
Administer and provide direction on software modifications to Security Constrained Unit Commitment, Real-Time Scheduling, unit commitment, dispatch and pricing programs, including enhancements related to MIP solution approaches, dynamic reserves procurement, account for constraint-specific transmission shortages, modeling generator duct firing operational limitations, participation models for Energy Storage Resources, Co-located Storage Resources, aggregation resources, distributed energy resources, large load participation models in wholesale electricity markets, scarcity pricing enhancements, external transaction pricing, and broader regional market initiatives.
Lead or coordinate proof-of-concept testing, user acceptance testing and implementation readiness activities for changes to core energy market algorithms and supporting market software.
Provide implementation support to product teams by reviewing requirements documents, reviewing and approving design notes, supporting user acceptance test plans, and ensuring enhancements and new features are ready for production deployment.
Oversee technical support to Market Monitoring, IT Quality Assurance, Stakeholder Services, Market Validation, and Operations for market participant questions, scheduling and pricing outcome validation, production investigations, and audit-related inquiries.
Support corporate SOC1 process and procedure audit principles by promoting best practices, periodic audit activities, traceable documentation, and disciplined production-support processes.
Direct, support, and maintain specialized operations and market-solution applications, including PMU applications, stand-alone visualization software, as applicable to the assigned functional portfolio.
Monitor FERC, regional ISO/RTO, academia, and industry developments; collaborate with other ISOs/RTOs on technology and business solution evaluation; and recommend technical and business evolution initiatives in coordination with NYISO senior management.
Represent NYISO on external industry advisory boards and in industry organizations such as PSERC, EPRI, CEATI, CIGRE, national labs, universities, and other research forums; participate in major national and international conferences and seminars.
Oversee external research engagements for NYISO, including active management of university and research organization collaborations, review of DOE, NSF, NYSERDA, and related proposals, and maintenance of an active research program aligned with NYISO market needs.

Supervisory Responsibilities

This position has supervisory responsibility and may have both managerial and non-supervisory employees reporting to the position. The role is expected to provide leadership, coaching, prioritization, and performance direction for technical staff and subordinate leaders supporting market solutions, research, modeling, testing, implementation, and production-support activities.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations Research, or another related technical field is required. Knowledge of Power Systems Engineering and Economics is preferred. A Master’s degree is strongly preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
A minimum of ten years of electrical engineering and/or software development experience is required, including technology leadership or supervisory experience in research, technology analysis, market systems, electric utilities, interconnected public service, or energy markets; or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.
Experience should include knowledge of power system operations, system planning, electricity markets, computer systems, optimization modeling, application software development, data engineering, scripting, and shell programming. For the senior manager role, demonstrated progressive leadership of complex market technology initiatives, cross-functional implementation teams, vendor relationships, external research engagements, and production support functions is expected.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

None required.
